name: ウェンデル
desc: Old gate captain with close-cropped white hair and a thick white moustache, lined stern face, upright broad build, dented steel breastplate over a faded royal-blue tabard, heavy rectangular tower shield painted with a city-gate emblem, a large iron gate key hanging from his belt

name: ピッパ
desc: Freckled shepherd girl with messy strawberry-blonde braids, sunburnt cheeks and a grin, small wiry build, undyed wool tunic with a green patched shawl and sheepskin vest, simple short bow, a leather sling coiled at her hip and a little brass sheep bell on a cord

name: オズリック
desc: Portly red-faced village priest with a tonsured balding head and stubble, sly half-smile, rumpled brown monk's habit with a rope belt and a stained white stole, a wooden staff with a crooked holy symbol, a clay wine jug tucked under one arm

name: レーネ
desc: Quiet locksmith woman with a short dark-auburn bob tucked under a soot-grey kerchief, narrow sharp face, slim build, charcoal leather apron over a rust-red work shirt with rolled sleeves, a thin stiletto dagger, a ring of lockpicks and tiny brass gears clipped to her belt

name: ブラム
desc: Eager young blacksmith's son with shaggy chestnut hair and a soot smudge on his cheek, broad muscular shoulders, sleeveless tan work shirt under a scorched leather smith's apron and leather bracers, a freshly forged bright steel longsword with an unwrapped tang-grip, a small hammer hanging at his hip

name: ラグナ
desc: Northern rune-singer crone with long silver-white braids threaded with bone beads, deeply wrinkled weathered face with blue chin tattoo lines, small hunched build, layered grey wool robes and a white bear-fur mantle, a gnarled driftwood staff carved with runes, a necklace of carved bone runestones

name: エイリーク
desc: Huge Norse ex-raider with a wild braided red beard and shaved sides with a long red topknot, scarred grinning face, massive build, chainmail under a dark wolf-pelt cloak and studded leather, an enormous axe-like broad greatsword over his shoulder, an iron arm ring carved with a ship

name: ソルヴィ
desc: Pale frail boy with frost-white hair and icy pale-blue eyes, frosted eyelashes, thin build, oversized pale-blue knitted wool coat and long scarf, three layers of mismatched thick gloves on his hands, a short birch wand rimed with ice, small ice crystals drifting around his fingers

name: トーラ
desc: Sturdy fjord fisherwoman with a thick dark-blonde braid wrapped around her head, windburnt tanned face, broad strong build, oiled seal-leather coat over a navy wool dress with rolled sleeves, a shield made of nailed ship planks with a painted wave, a barbed whaling harpoon in her other hand

name: ウルフ
desc: Lean smirking smuggler with a scruffy black beard and a fur-lined leather cap with ear flaps, foxlike face with a gold tooth, wiry build, patched brown coat with many pockets and a fox-fur collar, a curved skinning knife, a large bundle of furs strapped to his back

name: 篝
desc: Composed onmyoji woman with long straight black hair tied low and a tall black eboshi cap, calm narrow eyes and an ink smudge on her finger, slender build, white and deep-violet layered kariginu court robes with wide sleeves, a fan of paper ofuda talismans in one hand, a bundle of rolled scrolls tied at her back

name: 権左
desc: Grizzled checkpoint guard with grey-streaked topknot and heavy brows, square stubbled jaw, big heavy build, faded indigo samurai-retainer armor with lacquered shoulder plates and a straw rain cape, a large wooden standing pavise shield with an iron rim and a crest, a short sword at his side

name: 小夜
desc: Bright young falconer with a high black ponytail and a red headband, lively round face, athletic build, short ochre kimono with tied-up sleeves over dark hakama and leather leg wraps, a tall asymmetric Japanese yumi bow, a hawk perched on her thick leather falconry glove

name: 右近
desc: Blind biwa monk with a shaved head and closed eyes, serene thin face with a wispy white beard, slight build, dark grey travelling monk's robes with a straw hat hanging behind his back, a biwa lute held across his chest, a long prayer-bead rosary wrapped around one wrist

name: 伊吹
desc: Proud swordswoman with a short choppy black hair and one long lock framing her face, sharp confident eyes and a thin scar on her chin, lean athletic build, crimson haori jacket over a black kimono and white hakama, a long katana and a short wakizashi at her waist, a small worn notebook tucked in her sash

name: ファリダ
desc: Serene oasis well-keeper with dark hair under a flowing turquoise headscarf, warm brown face with henna-patterned hands, soft full build, long layered indigo and turquoise robes with silver coin trim, a tall staff topped with a copper water-drop ornament, a dripping clay water jar on her hip

name: ラシード
desc: Sly former treasury keeper with a neatly trimmed black moustache and goatee, hooded clever eyes, slim build, rich wine-red silk vest over a cream shirt, a gold-embroidered sash and a small black turban with a jewel, a jeweled curved dagger, a jeweler's loupe on a chain around his neck

name: アミン
desc: Excitable alchemist apprentice with wild curly black hair, one singed eyebrow and soot on his face, skinny build, scorched sand-colored tunic with a stained orange apron and goggles pushed up on his forehead, a brass-tipped short rod, several bubbling glass vials strapped across his chest

name: カヒナ
desc: Proud desert-nomad archer with dark braids under a deep-indigo veil wrapped around her head, sun-dark face with blue tribal tattoos on chin and forehead, tall lean build, layered indigo robes with a red sash and silver amulets, a recurve horn bow, a camel-bone quiver with striped fletching

name: ハムザ
desc: Massive freed gladiator with a shaved bald head and a short grey beard, heavily scarred arms and a broken nose, huge muscular build, bronze shoulder guard and studded leather kilt with a sand-colored sash, a big round bronze shield with a lion face, a broken iron shackle still on one wrist

name: イツェル
desc: Shy runaway sun-temple maiden with long black hair with blunt bangs, downcast eyes and gold face paint dots, slender build, white cotton huipil dress embroidered with red and gold sun patterns, a green quetzal-feather headdress, a short obsidian ritual knife and a small golden sun disc pendant

name: クアウ
desc: Fierce jaguar warrior with black hair in a high tail, bold black and yellow face paint, muscular athletic build, a full jaguar-pelt cloak with the head as a hood, quilted cotton armor and jade ear spools, a wooden macuahuitl club-sword edged with obsidian blades

name: ソチ
desc: Sardonic jungle herbalist with long greying black hair tied with vines, sharp grinning face chewing a leaf, wiry build, green and brown woven wrap dress with many herb pouches and a necklace of seeds, a long carved blowgun, a gourd of poison darts at her hip

name: テクン
desc: Silent temple guard with cropped black hair and a solemn broad face with red stripe paint, heavy powerful build, white quilted cotton armor with a turquoise-and-red feathered collar, a large round carved stone shield inscribed with rows of glyph names, a short obsidian-edged spear

name: ヤレツィ
desc: Wise old calendar-reader with long white hair in two braids with jade beads, deeply wrinkled cheerful face, small stooped build, deep-red and ochre woven robes with star-glyph embroidery, a tall staff tipped with a carved jaguar head, a round carved stone calendar disc strapped to her back

name: ヴィクトル
desc: Grim vampire hunter with greying black hair swept back and a short salt-and-pepper beard, gaunt scarred face with tired eyes, tall lean build, long black leather greatcoat with high collar and a wide-brimmed hat, a heavy crossbow-like longbow, a bandolier of silver-tipped arrows and a silver holy sigil

name: リゼット
desc: Wary gravedigger girl with straight jet-black hair with a crooked fringe, pale face with dark circles and a smirk, small thin build, patched dark-purple hooded cloak over a grey dress and muddy boots, a short curved knife, a glowing cursed ruby ring on her finger she keeps tugging

name: カシミール
desc: Haggard former plague doctor with untidy dark-brown hair and a thin face with sunken eyes and stubble, lean build, long dark-green physician's coat over a black waistcoat, a plague-doctor beak mask hanging at his belt, an old necromancy tome bound in chains, a pale violet glow in his other hand

name: アガーテ
desc: Stern elderly nun with a strict lined face and steel-grey eyebrows, sturdy build, black nun's habit with a white wimple and a tarnished silver trim, a heavy iron mace-like censer swinging on a chain, knitting needles and a half-knitted grey scarf tucked in her belt

name: バスティアン
desc: Gentle giant gravekeeper with messy ash-blond hair and a sleepy easygoing face covered in unbandaged cuts and scars, huge hulking build, tattered grey gravekeeper's coat over mismatched dark iron plates, a coffin-lid slab used as a great shield, a long iron shovel slung over his back
